summary: Iteration 3 validated the expanded clinical patient form (frontend + backend). Backend pytest: 9/9 passed (full-body create echoing all 19 fields, list, duplicate cedula -> 400, update persists, name-only minimal create, empty body -> 422, soft delete, auth required). Frontend Playwright flow: login (jcascante/Cardio2026) -> tab-pacientes -> new-patient-btn opens patient-modal -> typed multiple characters into pf-name AND pf-cedula with focus retained on each keystroke (regression PASS) -> saving with empty phone shows Spanish toast 'teléfono' -> filling full form with pf-sex, pf-blood_type dropdowns, save creates patient-row-0 with Nombre/Cédula/Edad/Sexo/Teléfono/T.Sangre columns -> duplicate cedula second save shows backend 400 error toast -> patient-edit-0 opens prefilled modal (occupation editable to 'Cardiologo') -> patient-search filters by name and cedula correctly -> tab-casos new-case-btn opens case-modal with case-patient dropdown listing created patient -> tab-diapositivas: slide-title + new-slide-btn file-chooser uploads PDF, slide-card-0 appears, slide-open-0 opens slide-viewer with toolbar (slide-prev/slide-fullscreen/slide-share/slide-download/slide-next). No regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: PatientModal save catches server errors via apiErr(e) which should surface backend 'Ya existe un paciente con esa cédula' detail — confirmed working in UI.
Field/SelectField/AreaField are correctly defined at module scope which is why focus is retained; regression test passes. Keep them outside the component.

Backend update_patient PUT uses full body replace; omitted fields are set to empty-string defaults from PatientIn — frontend always sends full form so safe, but any partial PATCH consumer would clear fields. Not an issue for current UI.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 patient 'Juan Perez TEST' (cedula 1-2345-6789) and 1 presentation 'TEST_Slide iter3' under jcascante. Pytest cleans up its TEST_-prefixed patients via soft-delete.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Expanded PatientsTab is fully functional. Focus retention regression validated — Field/SelectField/AreaField must remain module-scoped to prevent re-mount on each keystroke. Backend enforces per-owner cedula uniqueness in both POST and PUT.
